We need to answer: "What exact date does my next invoice get generated? I need to plan around replacing my card."

We have policy excerpts about invoice generation dates. The question: "What exact date does my next invoice get generated?" The policy says: "A monthly plan is invoiced on the same day of the month as the workspace's original billing date — the date the subscription started or last renewed." Also: "That date is shown in Settings → Billing → Plan next to 'Next invoice', and it does not shift month to month even though months have different lengths; a billing date of the 31st bills on the last day of a shorter month." So answer: The next invoice date is the same day of month as original billing date, shown in Settings → Billing → Plan under "Next invoice". So we can tell them to check that. Also mention that replacing card a day or two before is enough. So answer: The next invoice will be generated on the same day of month as your original billing date, which you can see in Settings → Billing → Plan under "Next invoice". If your billing date is the 31st, it will bill on the last day of shorter months. Replacing card a day or two before is enough. Provide that.
